up: List all approved drugs whose mechanism of action is classified as AGONIST. For each drug, return the following columns: molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule preferred name, target ChEMBL ID, target preferred name, target organism, mechanism of action, and canonical SMILES. Only include drugs with max_phase = 4 and match action_type = 'AGONIST'. Include structures (canonical SMILES) for the drugs.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS molecule_pref_name,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  dm.mechanism_of_action,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM drug_mechanism dm
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'AGONIST';
